Elaine — thanks, really appreciate the clarity on constraints. Attached is a first-pass MAP (redwood_MAP_AstraNova_v1.xlsx) and a short SOW outline. Key points up front:

- Evaluation scope: 2-week technical eval in both AWS (us-west-2) and GCP (us-central1) with identical prompt sets and a focused production smoke test.
- Acceptance criteria: latency p50 < 180ms for 512-token window on dedicated lanes; 99.5% successful request rate during the smoke test; model regression <1.5% on our quality evaluation set.
- Marketplace/billing path: we recommend AWS Private Offer for the majority of committed spend, GCP Commitment (sustained use + committed spend) for the GCP lane, and direct invoice fallback for early pilot months if marketplace timing delays procurement.

Milestones (proposed):
1) 2027-02-22: MAP kickoff & security questionnaire handoff (we'll get SOC2 artifacts)
2) 2027-03-01: Deployment of eval instances (AWS & GCP) + access for AstraNova engineers
3) 2027-03-08: End of functional eval; team retrospective + initial acceptance scorecard
4) 2027-03-12: Finance & procurement review with draft SOW attached
5) 2027-03-18: Security sign-off target (you listed this)
6) 2027-03-24: Target go/no-go for PO + NAT (ready to convert to private offers)

Attachments referenced: redwood_MAP_AstraNova_v1.xlsx (MAP + tasks), SOW_AstraNova_draft.pdf (SOW skeleton)

If this looks reasonable I can loop in Tessa (pricing), Aditya (marketplace contracts), and Grace (CS/onsite) to firm up pricing and the DocuSign flow.

Best,
Alex Martinez
